The M1 InlineMultiDomain composition shape amendment landed at vsdd-cli commit 60eb150 has a gap: it doesn't address attribution honesty. Inline-single-agent multi-domain composition has been using git 'Co-authored-by: Solution Owner <so@vsdd-domains>' trailers performatively — claiming independent multi-domain review that didn't structurally occur. Phase 2b primer says prose commits 'carry Co-authored-by: TW + DR trailers'; treating that literally for inline-single-agent work is dishonest attribution. Fix: amend M1 to declare 'inline-single-agent composition uses Composition: footer naming model + applied lenses; git Co-authored-by trailers are reserved for actually-independent contributors (separate humans or separate agents).' Small amendment but resolves the attribution-honesty observation surfaced 2026-06-01.
